visualCharacteristics.structure: background image + heading + overlay card(heading + text + CTA)
visualCharacteristics.dataSource: authored slides (default) or article index (articles option)

contentPattern: Default (authored slides): each row = slide. Cell 1: photo. Cell 2: h2 headline, h3 card heading, paragraph, primary CTA link. Option articles (Carousel Condition (articles)): no authored slides; optional 2-cell config rows: source | JSON URL of the article data (default /query-index.json), limit | number of slides (default 3), paths | bulleted path globs (* = one segment, ** = any depth; omit = all rows with an id). Slides = newest articles (publishedDate desc, then priority High>Medium>Low, then title): full-bleed photo + white card with up to 2 badges (Recommended or Updated-within-45-days, then indication badge, then content badge), h3 title, reading time, Read now CTA. Labels from placeholders (readNow, recommended, updated, carousel labels).

options.label: Articles (slides built from an article index)
